name: Life ~Omoide no Hashi ni~
source:
This bridge has seen a lot of stories during its lifetime. Here are memories of some of its regulars - lovers, prostitutes, travelers, soldiers.

[From [url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2019/01/vn-of-month-november-2000.html]vndbreview[/url]]

This novel is an omnibus consisting of 6 stories, with one choice option per episode and single or multiple ending. As the protagonist you take the role of a spirit who lives on a bridge and observes people passing on it without being seen. This "bridge" bears the beginning and end of different encounters life scenarios, farewells, promises, passing, and recollections. In the central scenario, you follow the growth and life path of a girl named Charles from the perspective of the spirit on the bridge.

[Translated and edited from MineEroge's blog.]
translation:
这座桥在其一生中见证了很多故事。这里有一些常客的回忆——情人、妓女、旅行者、士兵。

[来自[url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2019/01/vn-of-month-november-2000.html]vndbreview[/url]]

这部小说是一部由6个故事组成的综合体，每集有一个选择，有单结局或多结局。作为主角，你扮演一个住在桥上的灵魂，观察人们在桥上经过而不被发现。这座“桥”承载着不同人生场景的相遇、告别、承诺、擦肩而过、回忆的开始和结束。在中心场景中，你从桥上的灵魂的角度追踪一个名叫查尔斯的女孩的成长和人生轨迹。

[从MineEroge的博客翻译和编辑。]
